what_this_is: Power of the paper's decision rule under a stated data-generating model. A property of the design under assumptions A1-A7, not a measured resolution and not a noise floor.

decision_rule.unit: certificate (20), resampled with replacement, all attempts carried
decision_rule.multiplicity: none in the paper; Bonferroni over 4 (per outcome) and over 17 (all paired differences) reported as sensitivities
decision_rule.implementation_here: exact bootstrap distribution (B -> infinity) over all 230,230 per-certificate difference configurations

assumptions.A1: K=20 certificates, R=3 replicates per (condition, certificate) cell
assumptions.A2: replicates independent Bernoulli given the cell success probability
assumptions.A3: cell probability ~ Beta(mean p, ICC), ICC = 1/(a+b+1), same ICC in both arms
assumptions.A4: certificate difficulty coupled across conditions by a Gaussian copula with r (r=1 shared, the paired-design reference; r=0.5; r=0 independent). Negative coupling not simulated; it would lower power further
assumptions.A6: effect is a shift in mean success probability p1 = p0 + d
assumptions.A7: single two-sided 95% comparison, as in the paper

p0_values.note: A and B have the same observed F3 rate (2/60), so under this model their simulations are identical; they are computed once.

success_pattern_likelihood.model: p_F3 = observed F3 rate, p_F1 = observed F1 rate, conditioned on the observed totals; indicative, not an estimate of ICC or r
